input: Any commit that modifies /moves/king_e8.text must also modify /turn/ply.num and be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to king_e8's own key, since king_e8 has gone off plan with amnesia, and the rule that already requires fourteen co-signatures on /moves/knight_b8.text and /moves/pawn_d7.text still applies.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/king_e8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
